[[Durmand]] is a [[Kryta]]n historian. He has helped to establish the facts behind [[Saul's Story|the rise of the White Mantle]], [[Togo's Story|the tengu accords]], and [[Turai's Story|the Battle of Jahai]], as well as [[Gwen's Story|Gwen's flight north]]. He also worked to establish the origins of the [[Margonite]]s, the [[grawl]]'s faith, and even the [[Orr]]ian [[undead]]. Likewise, he has scribes in his employ constantly transcribing books. He was helped many times with his research by [[Nicholas the Traveler|Nicholas Sandford]].

==Notes==
*He provides access to the missions in the ''[[Guild Wars Bonus Mission Pack]]''.
*Durmand will give you authorized versions of stories that you finish, as well as additional authorized versions for each discovery you make in [[Discovery Mode]].
*He is the narrator for the ''Bonus Mission Pack'' cinematics and has separate voice responses for when you enter any of the ''Bonus Mission Pack'' missions.

==Trivia==
*In ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'', Durmand is the founder and namesake of the [[gw2:Durmand Priory|Durmand Priory]], one of the three orders of Tyria.
